title: Goods of the hunt
creator: core
description: The five classes an animal gives when it is dressed (docs/design/HUNTING.md section 6), each under the animal base class. Their items come with the first hunted kinds and their drawings; a finer grade of a good is an item of its own.

classes.name: Meat
classes.description: Raw and cooked flesh. Raw, it is food that heals a little and spoils with the carcass.

classes.name: Hide
classes.description: Skins and pelts, scraped and tanned into leather.

classes.name: Bone
classes.description: Bones, antlers, teeth and claws: needles, handles and charms.

classes.name: Sinew
classes.description: Tendon: the cord and the bowstring.

classes.name: Feather
classes.description: Plumes and down: fletching and finery.
